draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base extends to the held-out customer-service domains (Insurance, Telecom and Utilities), where it achieves higher macro-F1 in each domain.
rationale: T1.r3–r5 show Wrenfold beats Fennick-Base on all three held-out domains (85.7>81.2, 83.9>80.4, 86.2>82.0). The evidence supports a definite extension claim, not merely "may extend." No statistical test is reported, so significance language must be avoided, but the directional advantage is established.
